description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Long-press at {x, y} for an optional duration in seconds. Refused with mirror_not_live or mirror_state_unknown when the mirror is not live or its state cannot be confirmed. Optional expect: text that must be on screen (OCR) first, else nothing is sent. Reports delivery and retry.
name: phone_longpress
